explication: Good First Issue Finder is a SvelteKit web app for helping newcomers find open-source issues. The main workflow is to authenticate with GitHub, search issues using the app, and browse issue and repository details. The sampled API confirms cookie-based authentication and GitHub GraphQL search; the app-page excerpts do not show how the UI invokes it, so that connection is marked unverified. Navigation and profile components are shown as an internal presentation layer. Other UI-to-route wiring is not established by the excerpts.
